descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Operations / Manufacturing / Production Officer is responsible for supporting daily production or service operations by coordinating schedules, monitoring progress, and ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Job Description: Packaging Shift Engineer Position Title Packaging Shift Engineer Function Operations – Packaging Work Center Reporting To Packaging Manager Experience Requirement 5–7 years of experience in Packaging / Production operations with shift-handling responsibility Key Responsibilities 1. Production & Shift Operations
• Plan and execute packaging activities as per monthly production plans and inspection schedules.
• Deploy manpower effectively based on shift workload and packaging requirements.
• Monitor production orders, confirm job execution, and ensure on‑time package completion.
• Plan activities considering space availability and readiness for upcoming orders.
• Coordinate piping, wiring, and overall package readiness as per drawings and customer requirements. 2. Manpower Supervision & Workforce Management
• Supervise operators and technicians during shift operations.
• Provide on‑the‑job technical guidance and resolve shop‑floor issues.
• Conduct toolbox talks at the beginning of each shift.
• Motivate the workforce to maintain high standards of productivity, discipline, safety, and quality. 3. Quality Assurance & NCR Management
• Offer completed jobs to Quality Control and support inspection activities.
• Attend inspections and close all punch points for package readiness.
• Raise and manage NCRs (internal & external) and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions.
• Implement in‑house rework solutions to minimize outsourcing and delays.
• Drive adherence to Zero NCR targets for the packaging department.
• undefined 4. Subcontracting & In‑Process Activities
• Plan, coordinate, and follow up on subcontracted activities, including:
• Blasting & Painting
• Piping fabrication and hydro testing
• Radiography Testing (RT)
• Pump Insulation
• Ensure subcontracted work meets quality, safety, and delivery commitments. 5. Materials, Consumables & Cross‑Functional Coordination
• Identify shortages in materials and consumables.
• Coordinate with Stores, Warehouse, Purchase, Planning teams for timely availability.
• Prepare consumable requirement forecasts and follow up for procurement.
• Coordinate maintenance activities during breakdowns to minimize downtime.
• Ensure calibrated tools and gauges are submitted to QC as per schedule. 6. Productivity & Performance Monitoring
• Maintain and review JCP (Job Capacity Planning) monthly.
• Ensure effective and optimal manpower utilization.
• Monitor execution of paperless production systems.
• Ensure accurate confirmation of production hours and SAP entries.
• undefined 7. Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement
• Implement and sustain Lean Manufacturing practices, including:
• 5S
• Kaizen
• Continuous Improvement initiatives
• Submit Kaizen proposals monthly and motivate employees to contribute improvement ideas.
• Conduct and participate in periodic 5S audits.
• Drive digital and paperless systems across packaging operations. 8. Training & Skill Development
• Identify training needs and conduct skill development programs for shop‑floor personnel.
• Support capability building to improve safety, quality, and productivity. 9. Safety, Health & Environment (ESH)
• Ensure strict adherence to safety policies and PPE usage.
• Conduct regular safe
